Package org.example.simu.model

Class ServicePoint

java.lang.Object
org.example.simu.model.ServicePoint
public class ServicePoint extends Object
Model entity representing a service point workstation within the pizzeria simulation.

Manages customer queueing, schedules completion events using stochastic generators, supports both single-channel and multi-capacity workstations (e.g., ovens, dining tables, couriers), and computes continuous time-weighted performance metrics (utilization and average queue length).

Version:
3.0
Author:
Illia, Niklas
